Manage api-keys

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/API-Keys](https://docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/API-Keys)
:::

```sh
bronto api-keys <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto api-keys create`](/reference/commands/api-keys/#bronto-api-keys-create) | Create a API key |
| [`bronto api-keys delete`](/reference/commands/api-keys/#bronto-api-keys-delete) | Delete a API key |
| [`bronto api-keys list`](/reference/commands/api-keys/#bronto-api-keys-list) | List api-keys |
| [`bronto api-keys update`](/reference/commands/api-keys/#bronto-api-keys-update) | Update a API key |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto api-keys create

Create a API key

```sh
bronto api-keys create [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | key=value pair for the request body (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | request body from file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto api-keys create -f name=x -f limit=10
bronto api-keys create --input body.json
```

## bronto api-keys delete

Delete a API key

```sh
bronto api-keys delete <id> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--yes` |  | bool |  | skip the confirmation prompt |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto api-keys delete <id> --yes
```

## bronto api-keys list

List api-keys

```sh

```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--reveal` |  | bool |  | show full secret values instead of masking them |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto api-keys list
```

## bronto api-keys update

```sh

```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | key=value pair for the request body (repeatable) |
